# What reading each MP3 fixture in this folder gives, written from the
# ID3v2.2/2.3/2.4, ID3v1 and MPEG audio specs (tool/make_mp3_tag_fixtures.py
# builds the files and says what each one tests). Replayed by
# native/linthra_core/src/tags/shared_cases_test.rs.
#
# Same columns as cases.txt: file, title, artist, album artist, album, track
# number, duration in microseconds, cover as hex; `-` is absent, NONE is a
# file left to another reader. Durations: a Xing, Info or VBRI frame count,
# else TLEN in milliseconds, else the bytes of audio over the bitrate.
